ic_device.name: NE555
ic_device.description: Precision timing circuit capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation in monostable or astable modes with adjustable duty cycle and TTL-compatible output sinking/sourcing up to 200mA.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: Start of timing input. TRIG < 1/2 CONT sets output high and discharge open
pins.evidence: Start of timing input. TRIG < 1/2 CONT sets output high and discharge open

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low
pins.evidence: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low

pins.name: CONT
pins.description: Controls comparator thresholds, Outputs 2/3 x VCC, allows bypass capacitor connection
pins.evidence: Controls comparator thresholds, Outputs 2/3 x VCC, allows bypass capacitor connection

pins.name: THRES
pins.description: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low
pins.evidence: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low

pins.name: DISCH
pins.description: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor
pins.evidence: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V. SE555 maximum is 18V.
pins.evidence: Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V. SE555 maximum is 18V.

port_dependencies.condition: Active low reset forces output low
Active low reset forces discharge low
Controls comparator thresholds for TRIG and THRES

functional_blocks.name: Resistor Divider
functional_blocks.description: Generates 1/3 VCC and 2/3 VCC reference voltages for comparators

functional_blocks.name: Trigger Comparator
functional_blocks.description: Compares TRIG voltage to 1/3 VCC threshold

functional_blocks.name: Threshold Comparator
functional_blocks.description: Compares THRES voltage to 2/3 VCC threshold

functional_blocks.name: Latch
functional_blocks.description: Set by trigger comparator, reset by threshold comparator or RESET

functional_blocks.name: Output Drive Stage
functional_blocks.description: High current output capable of sinking/sourcing 200mA

functional_blocks.name: Discharge Transistor
functional_blocks.description: Provides low-impedance path to GND when output is low
